name: Borussia Dortmund GmbH & Co. KGaA
notes: Latest accounts are FY 2025/26 (year to 30 June 2026), Group IFRS; revenue EUR 460,467 thousand (prior year EUR 526,019 thousand). Revenue breakdown: TV marketing EUR 168.5m is stated in the same release sentence; merchandising EUR 38.7m and conference/catering/misc EUR 45.1m are separate lines the club reports and are not summed into 'other'. Net debt is not stated: financial liabilities were EUR 28,489 thousand and unrestricted cash EUR 3,668 thousand at 30 June 2026 (not netted here). Forbes 2026 also lists 2024-25 revenue $579M (€531M) and operating income $109M (€100M). Forbes' page may require a browser user agent (403 otherwise); SI's summary of the Forbes 2026 list also gives Dortmund $2.2 billion (13th). Hans-Joachim Watzke left management in autumn 2025 and is now President of the e.V. Social count is the club's own approximate figure ('some 90 million') from the annual report signed 28 Sept 2026. Average attendance not found on a citable page. Evonik's holding is ultimately attributable to RAG-Stiftung (2020 notification). SIGNAL IDUNA is the stadium naming-rights partner (to 2031) as well as a shareholder.
ownership_summary: Borussia Dortmund GmbH & Co. KGaA is listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange (Prime Standard); at 30 June 2026 Bernd Geske held 8.60%, Evonik Industries 8.20%, SIGNAL IDUNA 5.98%, the club association BV Borussia 09 e.V. Dortmund 5.90%, PUMA 5.32% and Ralph Dommermuth Beteiligungen 5.03%, with 60.97% free float. Control sits with the association, which is the sole shareholder of the general partner Borussia Dortmund Geschäftsführungs-GmbH that manages the KGaA.
revenue_evidence: Consolidated revenue amounted to EUR 460.5 million, down EUR 65.6 million on the prior-year figure.
